title: ArcCivs 0.1.55: V4 one-shaft network, strict completed access and persistent route warnings
assumptions: Before is published 0.1.52 geometry V3; 0.1.53 dependency-only change is retained. After is V4. This assessment is source/planner sensitivity, not measured production income.

Generator probability, native tool compatibility, six-second base action, food slowdown, durability and one-output durable receipt are unchanged. Before and after use the same 95 percent cobblestone / 4 percent coal / 1 percent raw iron exclusive distribution with a suitable tool. Unsuited ore roll becomes cobblestone. Fortune/Silk do not multiply synthetic output.

Low/base/high: one equipped miner per owner, 1/10/16 owners, 0.25/1/4 active hours per owner-day. These are sensitivity assumptions, not enforced caps. Three miners triple both before and after; nights, food, travel, tool wear, full bags/storage and loaded chunks reduce real throughput. No offline catch-up.

Finite native excavation remains two base seconds per actual block, ideal upper bound1800actions/hour. Native getDrops(tool) determines output; geometry counts are not guaranteed items. Fixing a stuck route may restore real throughput but adds no work multiplier.

Exact compiled plans for every style, L1/L2/L3: V3 steps3561/4718/5875, unique clear targets2524/3346/4168, planned CB827/1093/1359, ladder15/19/23, torch132/176/220. V4 steps4119/5405/6691, unique clear targets2957/3887/4817, planned CB988/1290/1592, ladder14/18/22, torch160/210/260. Unique clear target count differences433/541/649 are net geometry volumes, not additional drops or same-footprint guaranteed earnings.

V4 non-shaft paid-floor CB targets974/1272/1570 versus V3 812/1074/1336: +162/+198/+234. Native matching blocks skip; sound shaft backing is retained; cave/liquid protection may add real paid repairs. These target counts are ceilings for planned states, not mandatory material debits.

V4 retains 3/4/5 main floors, one fixed ladder, reserved rear access, three primary arms plus four side spurs. Existing V2/V3 ordinals are frozen. The first physical V4 receipt retains legacy/V2/V3 provenance and commits an independent V4 cursor. Selection, inspection and advancing over matching cells do not grant items or consume stock.

Direct changes separately0Vault/0tokens/0playerXP. Existing resident skill cap40 is unchanged. Existing tool recipes, construction price, producer reserves and courier quantity conservation are unchanged. Current SELL and future SELL-off/contract transition remain separate; no new sale rate or monetary conversion is asserted.

Latest previously retrieved 168h ledger3381records/33924operations/27players was dominated by67million administrative Vault mint; it is context, not current normal player income. This patch changes no monetary payout, price or conversion, so it reuses that bounded context and does not infer a new redemption rate.

Runtime acceptance must show physical V4 work and native walking after activation. Teleport is not walking; persistent WARN identifies step/cycle/position across alternate focus targets. Native client feel remains unverified until actually observed.
